_comment: The live watcher's road graphs, one per service area (wgresponse.liveroads; founder 2026-11-17: "start with the Eagle valley and Aspen, download Colorado"). Each box is the union of the simulator's extended tiles for that valley (data/roads/provenance_ext.json). Cut with tools/fetch_roads_pbf.py (the simulator's highway classes and simplification; only the largest connected network is kept). Every one of the 279 demo homes in these boxes snaps to its graph within 300 m (median ~100 m). A leg is routed on the first area (by key) whose box holds both ends; any other leg keeps the planner's straight chord. Road data (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0 (https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright).
